title: Add User API Keys Table to Database Schema
description: Define and migrate a new Drizzle ORM table for securely storing user API keys.
details: Create a new table (e.g., userApiKeys) in db/schema.ts with columns: id (PK), userId (FK), serviceProvider (string), encryptedKey (string), createdAt, and updatedAt. Generate and apply the migration using Drizzle's tooling. Ensure userId is indexed and foreign-keyed to users table. Do not store any unencrypted key material.
test_strategy: Run migration locally and verify table creation. Write a unit test to insert and retrieve a row, ensuring schema integrity. Check that no plaintext keys are present in the database.

title: Implement Encryption/Decryption Utilities
description: Develop secure AES-256-GCM encryption and decryption helpers for API key storage.
details: Create lib/crypto.ts with encrypt and decrypt functions using Node.js crypto module. Use ENCRYPTION_KEY from environment variables. Ensure random IV generation, authentication tag handling, and proper error handling. Write JSDoc comments and ensure no sensitive data is logged.
test_strategy: Write unit tests for encrypt and decrypt functions, including round-trip tests and error cases (e.g., wrong key, tampered data). Validate that decrypted output matches original input.

title: Create Protected API Routes for Key Management
description: Build Next.js API routes for CRUD operations on user API keys, with session validation and encryption.
details: In app/api/keys/route.ts, implement POST (add), GET (list), PUT (update), DELETE (remove) handlers. Use better-auth to verify session and scope all queries by userId. Encrypt keys before storing and decrypt only when needed for outbound requests. Validate input with Zod. Never return decrypted keys to the client. Add a POST /test endpoint to validate keys by making a test request to the relevant provider.
test_strategy: Write integration tests for all endpoints using a mocked session and database. Test unauthorized access, CRUD flows, and key validation logic. Ensure decrypted keys are never exposed in API responses.

title: Develop Settings Page UI for API Key Management
description: Create a user-facing settings page in the dashboard for managing API keys using shadcn/ui components.
details: Add app/dashboard/settings/keys/page.tsx. Use shadcn/ui Form, Input, Button, and Table/List components for add, update, delete, and test actions. Fetch data from the backend API routes. Show clear success/error messages. Ensure the page is accessible and responsive. Add a navigation link in the dashboard sidebar.
test_strategy: Manual and E2E tests: log in as a user, add/update/delete/test keys, verify UI updates and error handling. Use Playwright or Cypress for automated E2E flows.

title: Implement Backend Proxy for Key Validation
description: Add backend logic to test user API keys by making a lightweight call to the selected provider, using decrypted keys securely.
details: In the API route, implement a /test handler that decrypts the user's key and makes a minimal request to the external AI service (e.g., OpenAI's /models endpoint). Return only success/failure and error messages. Ensure all outbound requests are server-side and never expose the key to the client.
test_strategy: Write integration tests for the /test endpoint with mocked external API responses. Simulate invalid, valid, and network error scenarios. Confirm that no decrypted key is ever sent to the client or logged.
